# Instant

**Class** · `ironwood.time.Instant`

```java
public final class Instant implements Comparable<Instant>
```

**Implements:** [`Comparable<Instant>`](../lang/Comparable.md)

An immutable epoch-second and nanosecond timestamp with ISO-8601 text.
